title: TMNRED, A Chinese Language EEG Dataset for Fuzzy Semantic Target Identification in Natural Reading Environments
description: TMNRED is an EEG dataset recorded from 30 native Chinese speakers during natural reading of news headlines and short sentences. Participants identified fuzzy semantic targets among target and non-target items. The dataset supports research on semantic processing of Chinese in naturalistic reading and includes raw and preprocessed data in BIDS format.
methods_description: Thirty healthy right-handed native Chinese speakers read 15-20 character sentences on a screen at their own pace. Each completed 8 blocks totaling 400 trials, with each trial lasting about 2.2 seconds including a fixation cross and inter-stimulus interval. Sensor-level analyses compared responses to target and non-target words.
